name: FGM-148 Javelin
description: A portable, shoulder-fired anti-tank missile system from Lockheed Martin designed to engage armored vehicles and other battlefield targets.

name: ATACMS
description: A surface-launched tactical ballistic missile from Lockheed Martin designed to strike targets at extended distances.

name: PAC-3 MSE
description: An advanced interceptor designed by Lockheed Martin to defend against ballistic and cruise missile threats.

name: Harpoon Block II
description: An anti-ship cruise missile designed by Boeing to engage surface vessels, with Block II adding enhanced targeting capabilities.

name: SLAM-ER
description: An air-launched standoff land-attack missile designed by Boeing for precision strikes against selected surface targets.

name: AARGM-ER
description: An advanced anti-radiation missile designed by Northrop Grumman to engage radar and other air-defense-related emitters.

name: ASTER 30
description: A surface-to-air interceptor designed by MBDA and used in air-defense systems to counter aircraft and certain missile threats.

name: Brimstone
description: An air-launched precision-guided missile developed by MBDA for engaging a range of surface targets.

name: Barracuda-100/100M
description: An air-breathing autonomous cruise missile configuration designed by Anduril for affordable production and flexible mission applications.

name: Barracuda-250/250M
description: A mid-sized member of the Barracuda-M cruise missile family, designed by Anduril to offer increased size, range, and payload capacity within the product family.

name: Barracuda-500/500M
description: The largest member of the Barracuda-M family, designed by Anduril for extended-range precision strike missions.

name: Tamir
description: An interceptor designed by Rafael and used by Israel's Iron Dome air-defense system to counter incoming rockets and other aerial threats.

name: Spike
description: A family of electro-optically guided missiles developed by Rafael for a variety of land, vehicle, and other military applications.

name: Storm Shadow
description: An air-launched, long-range cruise missile designed by MBDA for precision strikes against selected land targets.

name: Meteor
description: A beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile developed by MBDA to engage aerial targets.
